mechanism: Senna's stimulant laxative effects may reduce gastrointestinal transit time and impair absorption of fat-soluble vitamin E, while high-dose vitamin E may have mild anticoagulant properties that could theoretically potentiate senna-induced electrolyte losses.
action: Separate administration by 2+ hours and monitor for signs of malabsorption or electrolyte imbalances with chronic concurrent use; consider vitamin E supplementation adequacy if senna used regularly.
